parlays.title: Ladder step 2: 2 legs at FanDuel
parlays.correlation: One leg per game, so the book prices the ticket as the legs multiplied.
parlays.edge: For fun, not value: 2 protected lines our model agrees with (76% and 76% on the raw model numbers), at FanDuel's exact prices, multiplied to -178. $75 rides with $19 already banked. A win returns $117: $23 goes to the bank and $94 rides next. Bank 20, ride 80.
parlays.cutoff: A ladder rung is not re-entered. It stands or falls as posted.
parlays.why: Ladder step 2: two easier game lines at FanDuel, one per game, each one our projection clears comfortably. $75 rides with $19 banked. A win returns $117: bank $23 and ride $94 on the next step. Kept apart from the record, in dollars.
parlays.risk: Both legs have to hit; one miss ends the climb, but it cannot take money already banked. College score models are uncertain and their raw alternate-spread chances are not calibrated price edges. This is the fun of the climb; the book's official settlement controls, and a person settles the rung.
